facebook.content_angle: How East Auckland sellers who price their home correctly from day one consistently attract stronger offers faster and avoid the damaging cycle of price reductions that signal desperation to buyers
facebook.post_text:
Price it right the first time — or pay for it later. 🏡

Too many East Auckland sellers list high hoping to 'test the market' — then watch their property sit while buyers assume something is wrong with it.

Here's what the data actually shows:
👉 Homes priced accurately from day one attract more competing buyers in the first two weeks
👉 The first 14 days on market are your most powerful — overpricing burns that window permanently
👉 Price reductions signal uncertainty, giving buyers the upper hand at negotiation time

In these final weeks before winter, a correctly priced home in East Auckland moves. An overpriced one waits. ⏳

✔️ Work with someone who knows what comparable homes are actually selling for right now
✔️ Understand your buyer pool before you set your price — not after
✔️ One smart pricing decision at the start protects your result at the end

If you're thinking about listing before winter arrives, what's the one question you'd want answered about pricing your home?
